grammar.pattern: 把 / 行 / 架 / 群 / 束 / 双 / 台 / 张 / 支 / 只 / 种
grammar.purpose: Use noun classifiers to identify the counted thing
grammar.explanation: 两把椅子 counts chairs; 两双筷子 counts two pairs, normally four individual chopsticks. 一行字 uses háng, not xíng. 一只猫 uses zhī, unlike the adverb 只 zhǐ. 一架钢琴、一台电脑、一束花、一张纸、一支笔、一群人、两种饮料 illustrate common noun combinations. Classifier choice depends on the object and intended grouping, not just its English count.

examples.py: liǎng bǎ yǐ zi , yī shù huā .
examples.en: Two chairs and a bunch of flowers.

examples.py: liǎng shuāng kuài zi , sì gēn kuài zi .
examples.en: Two pairs of chopsticks, four individual chopsticks.

examples.py: yī háng zì , yī zhī māo .
examples.en: One line of writing and one cat.

commonMistakes.wrong: 两双筷子就是两根筷子。
commonMistakes.right: 两双筷子通常是四根筷子。
commonMistakes.why: Count pairs rather than individual sticks.

grammar.pattern: 顿 / 口 / 眼：动作计量
grammar.purpose: Distinguish a meal, a mouthful and a glance
grammar.explanation: 一顿饭 counts one meal occasion; 一口汤 a mouthful; 看一眼 a brief look. 喝一口 does not mean drinking the whole bowl, and 看一眼 is not evidence of reading every line. These action measures do not provide an exact time or physical volume without further context.

examples.py: yì qǐ chī yī dùn fàn .

examples.en: Take a mouthful of soup first.

examples.py: kàn yī yǎn tōng zhī , zài zǐ xì dú .
examples.en: Glance at the notice and then read it carefully.

commonMistakes.wrong: 看一眼就一定读懂全部内容。
commonMistakes.right: 看了一眼，还要仔细读内容。
commonMistakes.why: A brief glance does not guarantee full comprehension.

lines.zh: 今晚四个人吃饭，桌子够大吗？
lines.py: jīn wǎn sì gè rén chī fàn , zhuō zi gòu dà ma ?
lines.en: Is the table big enough for the four of us tonight?
lines.speaker: a

lines.py: gòu . zài ná liǎng bǎ yǐ zi jiù xíng .
lines.en: Yes. We just need two more chairs.
lines.speaker: b

lines.py: kuài zi fàng nǎr le ?
lines.en: Where are the chopsticks?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 右边。拿四双，再给每人放一张纸巾。
lines.py: yòu biān . ná sì shuāng , zài gěi měi rén fàng yī zhāng zhǐ jīn .
lines.en: On the right. Get four pairs and put a napkin out for each person.
lines.speaker: b

lines.py: jīn tiān yǒu shén me cài ?
lines.en: What's for dinner?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 白菜、鸡蛋和汤。你想喝什么？
lines.py: bái cài , jī dàn hé tāng . nǐ xiǎng hē shén me ?
lines.en: Chinese cabbage, eggs and soup. What would you like to drink?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 果汁吧，红茶也行。我不喝啤酒。
lines.py: guǒ zhī ba , hóng chá yě xíng . wǒ bù hē pí jiǔ .
lines.en: Fruit juice, or black tea. I don't drink beer.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 行，冰箱里还有可乐，你自己拿。
lines.py: xíng , bīng xiāng lǐ hái yǒu kě lè , nǐ zì jǐ ná .
lines.en: Okay. There's cola in the fridge too; help yourself.
lines.speaker: b

lines.py: tāng hǎo le , wǒ xiān cháng yī kǒu .
lines.en: The soup's ready. I'll taste it.
lines.speaker: a

lines.py: xiǎo xīn , hái hěn tàng , děng yī huì er .
lines.en: Careful, it's still hot. Wait a moment.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好。桌上这束花也是给今晚准备的？
lines.py: hǎo . zhuō shàng zhè shù huā yě shì gěi jīn wǎn zhǔn bèi de ?
lines.en: Okay. Are these flowers for tonight too?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 是啊，吃顿饭也可以好看一点。
lines.py: shì a , chī dùn fàn yě kě yǐ hǎo kàn yī diǎn .
lines.en: Yes. Dinner can look nice too.
lines.speaker: b

reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 今晚朋友来吃饭，一共四个人。桌子旁边原来只有两把椅子，我又从房间里搬来两把，把四双筷子放好。
lines.py: jīn wǎn péng you lái chī fàn , yī gòng sì gè rén . zhuō zi páng biān yuán lái zhǐ yǒu liǎng bǎ yǐ zi , wǒ yòu cóng fáng jiān lǐ bān lái liǎng bǎ , bǎ sì shuāng kuài zi fàng hǎo .
lines.en: There were four of us at dinner tonight. The table had only two chairs, so I brought two more from the room and laid out four pairs of chopsticks.

lines.zh: 陈宇带来一束花，我把它放在桌子中间。他问今晚有什么菜，我说有白菜、鸡蛋和汤，都是刚做好的。
lines.py: chén yǔ dài lái yī shù huā , wǒ bǎ tā fàng zài zhuō zi zhōng jiān . tā wèn jīn wǎn yǒu shén me cài , wǒ shuō yǒu bái cài , jī dàn hé tāng , dōu shì gāng zuò hǎo de .
lines.en: Chen Yu brought flowers, which I placed in the middle of the table. He asked about the food: Chinese cabbage, eggs and soup, all freshly cooked.

lines.zh: 陈宇想喝果汁，小周选红茶，王宁从冰箱拿了可乐。我自己倒水，四个人的杯子很快就不一样了。
lines.py: chén yǔ xiǎng hē guǒ zhī , xiǎo zhōu xuǎn hóng chá , wáng níng cóng bīng xiāng ná le kě lè . wǒ zì jǐ dào shuǐ , sì gè rén de bēi zi hěn kuài jiù bù yī yàng le .
lines.en: Chen Yu wanted fruit juice, Xiao Zhou chose black tea, and Wang Ning fetched cola from the fridge. I poured water for myself; soon all four cups contained different drinks.

lines.zh: 汤刚端上桌，陈宇就想喝一口。我让他等等，先吃别的菜。他把碗放下，却说光看着就觉得饿。
lines.py: tāng gāng duān shàng zhuō , chén yǔ jiù xiǎng hē yī kǒu . wǒ ràng tā děng děng , xiān chī bié de cài . tā bǎ wǎn fàng xià , què shuō guāng kàn zhe jiù jué de è .
lines.en: When the soup arrived Chen Yu wanted a taste immediately. I asked him to wait and try the other food first. He put down the bowl, saying the sight alone made him hungry.

lines.zh: 我们边吃边聊上次旅行，我拿出手机给大家看照片。每张照片都有一只猫，我说当地的猫比人还会找好吃的。
lines.py: wǒ men biān chī biān liáo shàng cì lǚ xíng , wǒ ná chū shǒu jī gěi dà jiā kàn zhào piān . měi zhāng zhào piān dōu yǒu yī zhǐ māo , wǒ shuō dāng dì de māo bǐ rén hái huì zhǎo hǎo chī de .
lines.en: We chatted about our last trip over dinner. I showed everyone photos on my phone. Each had a cat; I said the local cats were better than people at finding good food.

lines.zh: 这顿饭吃到八点。剩下的汤我放进冰箱，四个人一起收拾桌子，那束花留着，明天还想放在窗边。
lines.py: zhè dùn fàn chī dào bā diǎn . shèng xià de tāng wǒ fàng jìn bīng xiāng , sì gè rén yì qǐ shōu shí zhuō zi , nà shù huā liú zhe , míng tiān hái xiǎng fàng zài chuāng biān .
lines.en: Dinner lasted until eight. I put the remaining soup in the fridge. We cleared the table together and kept the flowers to put by the window tomorrow.

choices: Friends eat, chat and clear up together
